calls.text: 1 Journeyman Wireman calls for Maddox Electric at Animal Kingdom working 4-10’s and an 8 with a 10 pm start time. The scale is $32.64 an hour plus a 15% night shift differential. Site orientation is on Monday’s for English and Tuesdays for Spanish.

3 Journeyman Wireman calls for BVCC’s Holiday Services. The hours are 11pm to 7:30am, Monday through Friday the scale is $33.08 an hour plus a $3.50 night shift differential. You will need scaffold safety, working at heights, and confined space certificates. You will also need to pass Disney’s background check.
